diagnostics.message: The EKS cluster should wait for its control-plane log group to exist before enabling cluster logging. The explicit dependency on the log group is present, so no missing finding is warranted.

The cluster security-group rules can use the node security-group ID through local.node_security_group_id, so they must wait for the node security group to be created. This reference is not represented in the graph dependencies for the rule resource.

Node security-group rules that reference the cluster security-group ID through local.cluster_security_group_id must wait for the cluster security group to exist. No dependency is recorded for this conditional reference.
